prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: supplemental field CHAIN ATTACK animation for the existing game sprite, NOT a redesign.
The attached small 3-column 4-row sprite sheet is the exact edit/style target: retain its tiny 2.5-head SD proportions, large ash-gray tousled hair, cheerful amber-eyed boy, black wrap outfit with cobalt-blue edges, orange inner accent and orange sneakers. Match the existing crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, dark one-pixel outlines and restrained shading exactly. Do not use taller proportions, realistic anatomy, painted detail or a new art style. Keep the original face, hair silhouette, costume, palette and scale.
Make one transparent sprite sheet, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 complete full-body sprites, generous transparent padding, no labels or grid. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Every cell SAME zoom with soles at the same relative ground line. No sprite crosses a cell boundary.
Rows in exact order: front/south, left/west profile, right/east profile, rear/north. All six frames in a row face that row's direction, not sideways substitutions.
Columns are successive frames of a 0.5-second chain cast: 1 ready: knees slightly bend, chain wrist at hip; 2 draw-back: wrist draws back, off-hand balances, torso turns; 3 wind-up: chain arm rises back over shoulder, determined lively grin; 4 release: chain arm WHIPS FORWARD in the facing direction, distinct extended shoulder/elbow/wrist and braced feet; 5 follow-through: forearm follows down and torso unwinds; 6 recovery: arm relaxes back near hip, feet return to stance.
The arm must visibly articulate, not just rotate or translate an unchanged standing character. Keep feet planted and body height consistent. Chuheun starts smiling and has a focused determined open mouth at release; keep the cute original face.
Draw ONLY a tiny 2-3 link navy-blue steel chain stub attached to the moving wrist in EVERY frame. No long loop, rope, energy line, weapon, trail, flash, or detached chain. The game will draw the extending chain from that exact wrist continuously. Transparent background with real alpha, no shadows outside the character, no scenery. Output the entire regular 6x4 sheet.
layout: 6 columns x 4 rows: south, west, east, north
note: Only supplementary attack poses; existing standing/walking art is retained.
